extra.description_html:
About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Dutch speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in Dutch, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  •  Review pre-release AI model outputs in Dutch and evaluate them for accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality—would a native speaker say it this way? Fact-check each response against the provided source material. 

  • Test the Dutch experience against English: confirm feature parity, complete an end-to-end user journey using non-English input, and verify that the product correctly handles non-Latin scripts, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input.

  • Identify any display issues (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering poorly) and any localization errors—incorrect dates, numbers, currencies, units, or untranslated strings.

  • Document each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it—include steps taken, device and OS, locale, build ID, and supporting evidence. Retest after a fix ships to confirm it’s resolved.

  • Provide native-level insights on navigation and usability, calling out Dutch-specific nuances that only a fluent speaker would notice.

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office; due to the confidential, pre-release nature of the work, remote or work-from-home options are not available.

  • Assist with other linguistic projects as needed.

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual proficiency in Dutch, written and spoken, with an up-to-date sense of real-world usage across both everyday and technical contexts.

  • Confident using smartphones and laptops; comfortable working across both iOS and Android.

  • Strong attention to detail and fair, objective judgment when assessing quality.

  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed test scripts and guidelines, and clearly explain issues in English.

  • Previous experience in software/app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus, but not required if you bring the language skills and attention to detail.

 

Welocalize helps the world’s leading brands reach global audiences—and language testing is at the core of that mission. You’ll work alongside experienced linguists and testers on pre-release technology, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously.

If you’re a native-level Dutch speaker with a keen eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology intersect, we’d like to hear from you.

We’re running a short video data collection project for one of our clients. We’re looking for native Arabic speakers across multiple Arabic-speaking countries and dialects to record a 15–20 second video, speaking naturally in Arabic and looking directly into the camera. The videos collected will be used to help train and evaluate an AI model that distinguishes real, human-recorded video from AI-generated (synthetic) video.
 

Project Details: 

Start Date: ASAP 

Duration: 1 session  

Commitment: 1 hour.  

Job Type: Freelance 

Location: Malaysia/Oman/Kuwait/Jordan/Türkiye/UAE/Saudi Arabia/Qatar (Remote) 

Language/Dialects: Yemeni Arabic

Pay Rate: $4.00-$15.00 (Depending on country location)

lists.content:
18 years of age or older. 

Native Arabic speaker (self-identified). You may be asked to complete a brief screening step to confirm your dialect before your submission is finalized.

Record a single 15–20 second video in your native Arabic dialect. 

Speak naturally (no script). Suggested prompts: briefly introduce yourself, mention where you live, or talk about an interest/hobby. 

Look directly at the camera the whole time. 

After recording, answer a few short questions about yourself (e.g. age range, country, dialect) to help us organize the dataset.

Video quality: 1080p or higher  

Length: 15–20 seconds  

Framing: Head-and-shoulders, face centered and fully visible 

Lighting/background: Well-lit face (no harsh shadows), plain/neutral background 

Expression: Neutral/relaxed while speaking naturally 

Audio: Clear speech, no background noise, music, or echo 

Orientation: Portrait or landscape acceptable (hold steady, no shaky footage) 

Environment: Quiet indoor setting preferred 

Prohibited: Filters/beauty modes, sunglasses, hats/hoods, face coverings, headphones/earbuds, watermarks, stickers, borders, other people/pets in frame
lists.text: Recording specifications (must meet all to be accepted)

lists.content: Before you begin, you’ll be asked to review and accept a consent form explaining how your video and any information you provide will be used, stored, and who it will be shared with.

extra.description_html:
About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Hebrew speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Hebrew speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Hebrew, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Hebrew and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the Hebrew experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Hebrew, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

 

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

If you're a native-level Hebrew speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Turkish speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Turkish speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Turkish, and your judgment shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Turkish and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the Turkish experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Turkish, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

 

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

If you're a native-level Turkish speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

As a trusted global transformation partner, Welocalize accelerates the global business journey by enabling brands and companies to reach, engage, and grow international audiences. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below represent the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
 
OVERVIEW
 
We are looking for translators with experience in translating patents from English into Portuguese (Brazil)  (native-level fluency of Portuguese) with immediate availability for a patent translation project.
 
The ideal candidate will have strong experience in translating and proofreading patents, specifically in the field of Chemistry, Computer Science, Electricity.

Job Title: English to Portuguese (Brazil) Patent Linguist
Start Date: ASAP
Location: Remote
Task Type: Translation, Copy Edit
Content Type: Chemistry, Computer Science, Electricity
Expected Weighted Volume Per Week: +5,000 words
CAT Tool:  XTM
Employment Type: Freelance

  • Proficiency in using CAT tools like XTM for project management and quality assessment.

extra.description_html:
We’re running a short video data collection project for one of our clients. We’re looking for native Arabic speakers across multiple Arabic-speaking countries and dialects to record a 15–20 second video, speaking naturally in Arabic and looking directly into the camera. The videos collected will be used to help train and evaluate an AI model that distinguishes real, human-recorded video from AI-generated (synthetic) video.
 

Project Details: 

Start Date: ASAP 

Duration: 1 session  

Commitment: 1 hour.  

Job Type: Freelance 

Primary Location: Malaysia/Oman/Kuwait/Jordan/Türkiye/UAE/Saudi Arabia/Qatar (Remote) 

Language/Dialects: Gulf Arabic

Pay Rate: $4.00-$15.00 (Depending on country location)

lists.content:
18 years of age or older. 

Native Arabic speaker (self-identified). You may be asked to complete a brief screening step to confirm your dialect before your submission is finalized.

Record a single 15–20 second video in your native Arabic dialect. 

Speak naturally (no script). Suggested prompts: briefly introduce yourself, mention where you live, or talk about an interest/hobby. 

Look directly at the camera the whole time. 

After recording, answer a few short questions about yourself (e.g. age range, country, dialect) to help us organize the dataset.

Video quality: 1080p or higher  

Length: 15–20 seconds  

Framing: Head-and-shoulders, face centered and fully visible 

Lighting/background: Well-lit face (no harsh shadows), plain/neutral background 

Expression: Neutral/relaxed while speaking naturally 

Audio: Clear speech, no background noise, music, or echo 

Orientation: Portrait or landscape acceptable (hold steady, no shaky footage) 

Environment: Quiet indoor setting preferred 

Prohibited: Filters/beauty modes, sunglasses, hats/hoods, face coverings, headphones/earbuds, watermarks, stickers, borders, other people/pets in frame
lists.text: Recording specifications (must meet all to be accepted)

lists.content: Before you begin, you’ll be asked to review and accept a consent form explaining how your video and any information you provide will be used, stored, and who it will be shared with.

extra.description_html:
About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

As a Tech Linguistic Tester, you will primarily be proofreading and editing content already localized to your native language, making sure that you catch any errors in the content, such as: grammar, typos, syntax, punctuation, capitalization, political incorrectness, inconsistencies, and extra spaces between words or characters. You will sometimes be translating content from English to your native language. You will also be
checking UIs for functional issues.

lists.content:
The following is a non-exhaustive list of responsibilities and areas of ownership for this role:
 
• Write and report relevant bugs and errors using best practices through internal database system.
• Ability to undertake and prioritize tasks and issues quickly and efficiently.
• Native language skills and cultural awareness of native country.
• Good oral and written communication.
• Highly organized with attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
• QA various products in by accurately following testing instructions and test cases.
• Discover and report defects (bugs) using client specific bug tracking tools.
• Evaluate translations in the context of software, mobile apps and documentation.
• Be a subject matter expert for linguistic issues in the target language; be able to research and resolve linguistic questions.
• Adhere to project-specific quality standards, trademarks, style guides and client-preferred checklists and glossaries.
• Troubleshoot basic problems; be able to communicate effectively and escalate testing issues.
• Complete assigned tasks in a timely manner and of high quality.

• Ability to work onsite and/or well as client location.
• Native-level or fully bilingual fluency (both spoken and written language) in required language(s).
• Up-to-date awareness of current and common technical language usage in the target language.
• Strong English skills, both written and verbal.
• Experience with MS applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
• Ability to navigate networks and websites with different browsers.
• Basic knowledge of PC-hardware (desktop and laptop).
• Basic knowledge of smart phones (iPhone or Android).
• Familiarity with Android and iOS operating systems..
• 3+ years professional translation & localization experience.
• Familiarity with native culture and trends.
• Avid user of social media with familiarity with Facebook Family of Apps.
• Experience with consumer devices that provide utility like messaging, health, fitness, calendar, organization.

• Strong Company & Industry Awareness.
• Can establish & Develop Processes and procedures as part of a client program.
• Strong Problem-Solving skills as to arrive at optimal solution.
• Shows excellent Time Management skills.
• A Plan-Do-Check-Act cycle approach to tasks and workloads.
• Takes Ownership of deliverables.
Be organized and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
• Candidates with Localization/QA/translation experience or with advanced computer skills are preferred.
Knowledge of common technological terms in English and target language.
Flexibility with varying hours.

Welo Data is an award-winning localization and data transformation company. We run one of the world's largest Ads Rating Programs and we want you to join!  
 
As an Ads Quality Rater , you will review and grade internet advertisements to help shape how ads are delivered to the end users.  In other words, you'll tell the AI ​​program how good or bad its advertisement suggestions are based on the user's keywords.
 
You will review ads in both English and Czech
 
This role is great for people who:  
 
- Surf the internet daily  
- Use major search engines frequently  
- Know what people want based on a few keywords  
- Enjoy researching topics online
- Want a flexible and fun side job
 
Project Details  
 
Job Title: Ads Quality Rater Czech (Slovakia)
Pay Rate: Based on tasks (approximately $8 per hour)
Location: Remote/work from home - must be based in Slovakia
Hours: Set your schedule based on the following – Minimum commitment is 5 hours per week. You can choose to work up to 20 hours per week.
Start Date: ASAP
Employment Type: Independent Contractor/Freelance/Self-Employed 
Project Duration:  Long term
 
Notes:
- Even though the position is WFH, you must reside in the country that is noted in this description. This will be automatically checked during the hiring process.
 
Recruitment Process
 
- There is no formal interview for this job! No phone calls, no waiting, and no wasting time wondering whether you got the job or not.
 
- Instead, you will be guided through a self-paced and automated recruitment process.
 
IMPORTANT NOTE: Welo Data uses numerous identity checks to ensure that everyone who makes the team is real, qualified, and ready to work. To avoid any misunderstandings, do not use IP masking programs (such as VPNs).

Experience & Requirements  
- Fluency in Czech

- Strong understanding of English (written and spoken)

- Comfortable knowledge of modern popular culture

- Reliable computer system and internet connection

- Familiar with using online search engines

- Sign a standard Non-Disclosure Agreement and Service Level Agreement

Please note that this work is based on project needs. Due to this, weekly hours may vary and flexibility with change is expected. You must legally be able to work on freelance projects in Slovakia .
 
To know more details (Click here)

Ort: Spanien, Remote (Homeoffice)
Art: Freiberuflich, Teilzeit, Flexible Arbeitszeiten
 
Über die Rolle:
Wir suchen eine motivierte und technikaffine Person, die unser Team als Deutsche Anzeigenprüfer*in verstärkt. In dieser Rolle bist du dafür verantwortlich, Internetanzeigen zu überprüfen und zu bewerten, um sicherzustellen, dass sie relevant, genau und effektiv für die Endnutzer innen sind. Dies ist eine fantastische Gelegenheit für Personen, welche gerne im Internet surfen, häufig große Suchmaschinen nutzen und Spaß daran haben zu verstehen, was Menschen basierend auf wenigen Stichwörtern suchen. Wenn du gerne online recherchierst und einen flexiblen und unterhaltsamen Nebenjob suchst, ist diese Position perfekt für dich!

Wichtige Aufgaben:
- Bewertung der Qualität und Relevanz von Online-Anzeigen auf Deutsch.
- Überprüfung von Anzeigen und -platzierungen, um sicherzustellen, dass sie bestimmte Kriterien und Richtlinien erfüllen.
- Feedback geben und Vorschläge zur Verbesserung der Anzeigenqualität und -effektivität machen.
- Durchführung von Keyword-Recherchen, um die Benutzerabsicht zu verstehen und die Anzeigenschaltung zu verbessern.
- Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Identifizierung von Trends und Verbesserung der Anzeigenschaltstrategien.

Qualifikationen:
- Muttersprachliche Deutschkenntnisse und starkes Verständnis der deutschen Kultur und Online-Trends.
- Gute Englischkenntnisse für Kommunikations- und Berichtszwecke.
- Regelmäßige*r Nutzer*in großer Suchmaschinen und Social-Media-Plattformen.
- Hervorragende Recherchefähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, Informationen schnell zu analysieren.
- Detailorientiert mit starken analytischen und problemlösenden Fähigkeiten.
- Zuverlässige Internetverbindung und geeignete Arbeitsumgebung zu Hause.

Ideale Kandidat*in:
- Surft täglich im Internet und ist mit verschiedenen Online-Plattformen vertraut.
- Hat Erfahrung mit großen Suchmaschinen wie Google, Bing etc.
- Versteht, was Menschen basierend auf minimalen Informationen oder Stichwörtern suchen.
- Recherchiert und lernt gerne über neue Themen online.
- Sucht einen flexiblen Remote-Job, der mit anderen Verpflichtungen vereinbar ist.

Vorteile:
- Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die zu deinem Zeitplan passen.
- Arbeite bequem von zu Hause aus (innerhalb von Spanien).
- Gewinne Einblicke in die digitale Werbeindustrie.
- Verbessere deine Recherche- und Analysefähigkeiten.
- Sei Teil eines dynamischen und unterstützenden Teams.

So bewirbst du dich:
Wenn du an dieser spannenden Gelegenheit interessiert bist, sende bitte deinen Lebenslauf, indem du unten auf "Bewerben" klickst. Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören!

extra.description_html:
Overview

Welo Data is looking for sharp, curious, and detail-oriented individuals to join our team as Data Labeling Associate.

This is not a traditional annotation role.

You’ll be working directly with cutting-edge AI systems — evaluating outputs, identifying gaps, and helping improve how these systems behave in real-world scenarios. The work sits at the intersection of data quality, model evaluation, and human judgment, where your ability to think critically matters just as much as following guidelines.

We’re looking for people who are naturally curious about AI, comfortable forming opinions, and confident in contributing to conversations with teammates, leads, and stakeholders.

Project Details

  • Job Title: Data Labeling Associate
  • Hiring in: Onsite (Bay Area, Seattle, NYC, or client-dependent) 
  • Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week
  • Employment Type: W2 Full-Time Employee
  • Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. (no visa sponsorship)
  • Pay Rate: $34/hour

 

Important: This is a 100% onsite position — remote work is not available for this role. To be considered, candidates must be located in or able to commute to one of the following cities: NYC, Seattle, Bellevue, Redmond, San Francisco, Sunnyvale, Burlingame, Austin, Los Angeles, Washington DC, Chicago, Boston, Austin. Please only apply if you meet this location requirement.

• Evaluate AI model outputs and provide structured, high-quality feedback
  • Perform audit-based reviews of data and model behavior — identifying patterns, edge cases, and failure modes
  • Apply guidelines thoughtfully — and flag when they don’t reflect real-world scenarios
  • Contribute to improving evaluation frameworks, not just executing them
  • Identify trends in model performance and communicate insights clearly
  • Participate in team discussions, calibrations, and stakeholder syncs
  • Partner with leads and cross-functional teams to refine quality standards
  • Document findings in a clear, concise, and actionable way

• Native-level Italian language proficiency and a university degree (Bachelor’s or higher).
  • B2 or superior level of English.  
  • 1–2 years of professional writing experience with strong, structured writing skills
  • Ability to apply complex writing rules and guidelines consistently
  • Strong understanding of safety considerations in GenAI data delivery, with 2+ years of relevant experience
  • Strong critical thinking and attention to detail
  • Ability to make sound judgment calls in ambiguous situations
  • Naturally curious about AI, technology, and how systems behave
  • Comfortable speaking up, asking questions, and contributing ideas
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to stay consistent while working with evolving guidelines
  • Experience in data quality, QA, annotation, or analysis is helpful — but not required

• Paid Vacation: 6 days
  • Paid Company Holidays: 2 days (Memorial Day and Labor Day)
  • Paid Sick Leave: accrued per applicable state law and company policy
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (eligibility applies)
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Unique Campus Features: Some locations include roof-top nature parks
  • Commuter Benefits: Free transport, shuttles, and sometimes bike-to-work perks.

Welo Data is looking for sharp, curious, and detail-oriented individuals to join our team as Data Labeling Associate.
This is not a traditional annotation role.
You’ll be working directly with cutting-edge AI systems — evaluating outputs, identifying gaps, and helping improve how these systems behave in real-world scenarios. The work sits at the intersection of data quality, model evaluation, and human judgment, where your ability to think critically matters just as much as following guidelines.
We’re looking for people who are naturally curious about AI, comfortable forming opinions, and confident in contributing to conversations with teammates, leads, and stakeholders.
Project Details
Job Title: Data Labeling Associate
Hiring in: Onsite (Bay Area, Seattle, NYC, or client-dependent) 
Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week
Employment Type: W2 Full-Time Employee
Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. (no visa sponsorship)
Pay Rate: $34/hour
 
Important: This is a 100% onsite position — remote work is not available for this role. To be considered, candidates must be located in or able to commute to one of the following cities: NYC, Seattle, Bellevue, Redmond, San Francisco, Sunnyvale, Burlingame, Austin, Los Angeles, Washington DC, Chicago, Boston, Austin. Please only apply if you meet this location requirement.

What You’ll Do
- Evaluate AI model outputs and provide structured, high-quality feedback

- Perform audit-based reviews of data and model behavior — identifying patterns, edge cases, and failure modes

- Apply guidelines thoughtfully — and flag when they don’t reflect real-world scenarios

- Contribute to improving evaluation frameworks, not just executing them

- Identify trends in model performance and communicate insights clearly

- Participate in team discussions, calibrations, and stakeholder syncs

- Partner with leads and cross-functional teams to refine quality standards

- Document findings in a clear, concise, and actionable way

What We’re Looking For
- Native-level Italian language proficiency and a university degree (Bachelor’s or higher).

- B2 or superior level of English.

- 1–2 years of professional writing experience with strong, structured writing skills

- Ability to apply complex writing rules and guidelines consistently

- Strong understanding of safety considerations in GenAI data delivery, with 2+ years of relevant experience

- Strong critical thinking and attention to detail

- Ability to make sound judgment calls in ambiguous situations

- Naturally curious about AI, technology, and how systems behave

- Comfortable speaking up, asking questions, and contributing ideas

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Ability to stay consistent while working with evolving guidelines

- Experience in data quality, QA, annotation, or analysis is helpful — but not required

Benefits
- Paid Vacation: 6 days

- Paid Company Holidays: 2 days (Memorial Day and Labor Day)

- Paid Sick Leave: accrued per applicable state law and company policy

- Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (eligibility applies)

- Health Savings Account (HSA)

- 401(k) Retirement Plan

- Employee Assistance Program

- Additional voluntary benefits (life, accident, critical illness, etc.)

- Free Gourmet Food: Free breakfast, lunch, and dinner are provided, featuring a wide variety of cuisines in multiple cafes.

- Micro-kitchens & Snacks: Offices are stocked with free snacks and beverages, including premium coffee and La Croix.

- Unique Campus Features: Some locations include roof-top nature parks

- Commuter Benefits: Free transport, shuttles, and sometimes bike-to-work perks.

¿Manejas los buscadores como un genio? ¿Encuentras lo que buscas con un par de palabras clave? Welo Data está buscando a una persona de habla española de España para participar en un proyecto de cliente como evaluador de calidad de anuncios (Ads Quality Rater). 

Usarás una herramienta única, basada en la web para evaluar los anuncios de los buscadores en función de las pautas del proyecto. 

Requisitos

- Fluidez en español
- Deberán ser de España y estar ubicados en Mexico
- 18+
- Alta comprensión del inglés, hablado y escrito
- Conocedor de la web y capacidad de trabajar en un entorno de ritmo rápido

extra.description_html:
Overview

Welo Data is looking for detail-oriented and reliable individuals to join our team as Data Labeling Analysts, supporting speech and voice AI systems.

This is a high-impact production role focused on building the datasets that power real-world AI systems. You’ll be working with audio, speech, and language data — helping ensure models are trained on accurate, well-structured, and representative inputs.

While this role is more execution-focused than evaluation-heavy roles, it still requires strong judgment, attention to detail, and consistency. The work sits at the intersection of language, data, and AI systems — where precision and discipline matter at scale.

We’re looking for people who are dependable, focused, and take pride in producing high-quality work, even across repetitive workflows.

Project Details

  • Job Title: Speech & Voice Ai Analyst
  • Hiring in: Onsite (Bay Area, Seattle, NYC, or client-dependent) 
  • Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week
  • Employment Type: W2 Full-Time Employee
  • Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. (no visa sponsorship)
  • Pay Rate: $28/hour
Important: This is a 100% onsite position — remote work is not available for this role. To be considered, candidates must be located in or able to commute to one of the following cities: NYC, Bellevue, Redmond, San Francisco, Sunnyvale, Burlingame, Los Angeles, Washington DC, Boston. Please only apply if you meet this location requirement.

lists.content:
• Execute high-volume data labeling and annotation tasks across speech and voice datasets
  • Follow detailed guidelines to ensure consistency, accuracy, and data integrity at scale
  • Work with audio and language data, including transcription, categorization, and tagging
  • Maintain strong throughput while meeting quality expectations
  • Escalate unclear or ambiguous cases appropriately
  • Adapt to evolving guidelines and workflows as systems and requirements change
  • Support baseline data production needs for AI training pipelines
  • Contribute to team calibrations and quality alignment sessions

• Native-level fluency in French 
  • Strong written communication skills and language fundamentals
  • 1 year of work experience in data labeling, annotation, or content-focused work; or a Bachelor's degree or equivalent academic qualification in a related field.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions and apply guidelines consistently
  • High attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy in repetitive tasks
  • Comfort working in structured, process-driven environments
  • Ability to manage time effectively and maintain steady output
  • Willingness to ask questions and escalate when needed
  • Basic familiarity with AI, speech technology, or language data is a plus

• Paid Vacation: 6 days
  • Paid Company Holidays: 2 days (Memorial Day and Labor Day)

extra.description_html:
Welo Data is an award-winning localization and data transformation company. We run one of the world’s largest Ads Rating Programs and we want you to join! 
 
As an Ads Quality Rater, you will review and grade internet advertisements to help shape how ads are delivered to the end users. In other words, you’ll tell the AI program how good or bad its advertisement suggestions are based on the user’s keywords.
 
You will review ads in both English and German
 
This role is great for people who: 
 
- Surf the internet daily 
- Use major search engines frequently 
- Know what people want based on a few keywords 
- Enjoy researching topics online
- Want a flexible and fun side job

Project Details  
 
Job Title: Ads Quality Rater
Pay Rate: Based on tasks (approximately $7 per hour)
Location: Remote/work from home - must be based in Brazil
Hours: Set your schedule based on the following – Minimum commitment is 5 hours per week. You can choose to work up to 20 hours per week.
Start Date: ASAP
Employment Type: Independent Contractor/Freelance/Self-Employed 
Project Duration: Long-term

Note:
- Even though the position is WFH, you must reside in the country that is noted in this description. This will be automatically checked during the hiring process.

Recruitment Process
 
- There is no formal interview for this job! No phone calls, no waiting, and no wasting time wondering whether you got the job or not.
 
- Instead, you will be guided through a self-paced and automated recruitment process.
 
IMPORTANT NOTE: Welo Data uses numerous identity checks to ensure that everyone who makes the team is real, qualified, and ready to work. To avoid any misunderstandings, do not use IP masking programs (such as VPNs).

Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.

At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech?
 
Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI.
 
By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms.
 
Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation.
 
What You’ll Need
- Native or near-native fluency in French
- Based in: Canada
- English proficiency
- Comfortable with digital tools
- Detail-oriented and curious
 
Why Join Us?
🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow
🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI
🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community
 
About our projects:
Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.
Depending on your skills, you might:
📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems
🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance
💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs)
🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy
Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you.
 
How to Apply?
Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community.
 
📬 Questions?
If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.

We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Sports Live Data Monitor/Content Moderator to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for monitoring our client's Sports App for errors and carrying out research about leagues and players.

Your primary goal will be to ensure the accuracy of both live and static data, promptly fixing issues as they arise.

Responsibilities:

- Monitor Live Sports Data across a wide range of European and American sports, leagues, and teams to ensure the accuracy of both live and static data.
- Track and update statistics in real-time within our sports application.
- Identify, mitigate, and escalate potential issues, following documented workflows.
- Stay updated on recent transactions, games, and statistics across a wide range of leagues

Qualifications:

- Passion for sports and a deep understanding of various sports, leagues, and teams.
- Strong attention to detail.
- Ability to monitor, track, and escalate live sports data.
- Ability to handle repetitive tasks.
- Native or near-native fluency in the English language.
- Previous experience in sports writing or editing is a plus.

Requirements:

Willingness to work flexible hours, including afternoons/night shifts, weekends as needed.


Position details: 

- Location: 100 % onsite at the office in Hollyhill, Cork, Ireland
- Salary: €35,000/year
- Contract: 1 year with possibility of extension
- Schedule Availability: Full-time (40 hours per week).

Schedule Availability:
40h/week with 30 min of unpaid lunch break
Tuesday-Saturday shift, starting at 7am and finishing at 3:30pm.
Sunday-Thursday shift, starting at 7am and finishing at 3:30pm.
Shifts will depend on the Client's needs and are not flexible.
However, working later hours could be a possibility. e.g 10:30 am to 7:30 pm.

Desired Start Date:
As soon as possible

Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.

At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech?
 
Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI.
 
By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms.
 
Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation.
 
What You’ll Need
- Native or near-native fluency in Burmese
- Based in: Myanmar, Thailand, Malaysia
- English proficiency
- Comfortable with digital tools
- Detail-oriented and curious
 
Why Join Us?
🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow
🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI
🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community
 
About our projects:
Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.
Depending on your skills, you might:
📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems
🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance
💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs)
🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy
Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you.
 
How to Apply?
Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community.
 
📬 Questions?
If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.

Specjalizujesz się w wyszukiwarkach internetowych? Potrafisz znaleźć to, czego szukasz, przy pomocy tylko kilku słów kluczowych?
 
Mamy dla Ciebie wyjątkową okazję sprawdzenia swoich umiejętności w praktyce!
 
Welo Data szuka polskojęzycznych pracowników mieszkających w Polsce do wsparcia projektu naszego klienta jako Ads Quality Rater.
 
Będziesz korzystać z wyjątkowego narzędzia internetowego w celu oceny reklam w wyszukiwarkach zgodnie z wytycznymi projektu.
 
Aplikuj dzisiaj i zacznij kształtować przyszłość Internetu!

o    Doskonała znajomość języka polskiego

o    WYMAGANE zamieszkanie na terenie Polski.
o   18+

About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Malay speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Malay speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Malay, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Malay and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the Malay experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Malay, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

 

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

If you're a native-level Malay speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

About Welo Global 

Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com  

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Welo Global is partnering with a social media client to build high-quality training data for AI systems. We are looking for Brazilian experts with PhD level to help create challenging, expert-level questions and answers in their field. The content that will directly shape how AI understands Brazilian culture, law, history, and society.

This is a remote, flexible freelance engagement. All work is done in Brazilian Portuguese.

What you'll do

For each assignment, you will craft a challenging, expert-level question on a Brazilian topic in your field (one that AI tools cannot fully answer), write the ideal response in Brazilian Portuguese and break that response down into individually cited facts with their sources and relevance.

Important: AI tools may be used for research support only. All questions, answers, and fact breakdowns must be your own original work.

We are looking for experts in the domain listed in the job posting. As a mandatory requirement, only experts with PhD level would be considered for the role.

Project details

  • Language Pair: Brazilian Portuguese
  • Task: AI data annotation
  • Area of expertise (domain): Religion, Spirituality or Philosophy
  • Tools: Consumer-grade LLM with search (e.g., Gemini Pro), for prompt difficulty calibration
  • Estimated Volume: 60 hours over approximately 2 months, the hours are flexible, work on your own schedule
  • Location: Remote
  • Engagement Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor

If this opportunity aligns with your experience, we would be happy to receive your application.

To proceed, please provide the following:

  • Share an updated CV
  • A brief overview of your relevant experience, particularly in Religion, Spirituality or Philosophy and how many years you have worked in the field
  • Your current availability and estimated monthly capacity

Thank you again for your interest in working with Welo Global. I look forward to learning more about your profile and exploring a potential collaboration.

Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global

Overview

Welo Data is looking for detail-oriented and reliable individuals to join our team as Data Labeling Analysts, supporting speech and voice AI systems.

This is a high-impact production role focused on building the datasets that power real-world AI systems. You’ll be working with audio, speech, and language data — helping ensure models are trained on accurate, well-structured, and representative inputs.

While this role is more execution-focused than evaluation-heavy roles, it still requires strong judgment, attention to detail, and consistency. The work sits at the intersection of language, data, and AI systems — where precision and discipline matter at scale.

We’re looking for people who are dependable, focused, and take pride in producing high-quality work, even across repetitive workflows.

Project Details

  • Job Title: Data Labeling Analyst
  • Hiring in: Onsite (Bay Area, Seattle, NYC, or client-dependent) 
  • Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week
  • Employment Type: W2 Full-Time Employee
  • Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. (no visa sponsorship)

text:

Welo Data is looking for detail-oriented and reliable individuals to join our team as Data Labeling Analysts, supporting speech and voice AI systems.

While this role is more execution-focused than evaluation-heavy roles, it still requires strong judgment, attention to detail, and consistency. The work sits at the intersection of language, data, and AI systems — where precision and discipline matter at scale.
We’re looking for people who are dependable, focused, and take pride in producing high-quality work, even across repetitive workflows.

About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Hindi (Romanized) speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Hindi (Romanized) speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Hindi (Romanized), and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Hindi (Romanized) and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the Hindi (Romanized) experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Hindi (Romanized), written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

 

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

If you're a native-level Hindi (Romanized) speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

extra.description_html:
About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Thai speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Thai speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Thai, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Thai and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the Thai experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Thai , written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

 

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

If you're a native-level Thai speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level German speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programe for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in German, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model outputs in German and evaluate them for accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality—would a native speaker say it this way? Fact-check each response against the provided source material. 

  • Test the German experience against English: confirm feature parity, complete an end-to-end user journey using non-English input, and verify that the product correctly handles non-Latin scripts, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input.

  • Identify any display issues (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering poorly) and any localization errors—incorrect dates, numbers, currencies, units, or untranslated strings.

  • Document each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it—include steps taken, device and OS, locale, build ID, and supporting evidence. Retest after a fix ships to confirm it’s resolved.

  • Provide native-level insights on navigation and usability, calling out German-specific nuances that only a fluent speaker would notice.

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office; due to the confidential, pre-release nature of the work, remote or work-from-home options are not available.

  • Assist with other linguistic projects as needed.

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual proficiency in German, written and spoken, with an up-to-date sense of real-world usage across both everyday and technical contexts.

  • Confident using smartphones and laptops; comfortable working across both iOS and Android.

  • Strong attention to detail and fair, objective judgment when assessing quality.

  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed test scripts and guidelines, and clearly explain issues in English.

  • Previous experience in software/app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus, but not required if you bring the language skills and attention to detail.

 

Welocalize helps the world’s leading brands reach global audiences—and language testing is at the core of that mission. You’ll work alongside experienced linguists and testers on pre-release technology, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously.

If you’re a native-level German speaker with a keen eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology intersect, we’d like to hear from you.

About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

As a Tech Linguistic Tester 1, you will primarily be proofreading and editing content already localized to your native language, making sure that you catch any errors in the content, such as: grammar, typos, syntax, punctuation, capitalization, political incorrectness, inconsistencies, and extra spaces between words or characters. You will sometimes be translating content from English to your native language. You will also be
checking UIs for functional issues.

lists.content:

About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Mandarin Chinese speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Mandarin Chinese, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Mandarin Chinese and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the Mandarin Chinese experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Mandarin Chinese, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

 

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

If you're a native-level Mandarin Chinese speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

Job Reference: #LI-JG1

OVERVIEW

Are you tech-savvy? Have a passion for quality? We are looking for Data Raters to work on projects aimed at advancing AI technologies. Join us for a unique chance to kickstart your career in the AI field!

This project is an excellent starting point for entry-level candidates. We offer comprehensive learning support, making it a great opportunity to gain experience in data annotation and data rating within the AI field—an industry currently in high demand for skilled specialists, especially those with expertise in localization and linguistic proficiency.

MAIN DUTIES:

*Follow guidelines to check the quality of filters and options in desktop and mobile views.
*Check if filters and options help customers make decisions or suggest good alternative products.
*Ensure filters and options match what customers are looking for based on their queries.
*Determine if the filters and options are relevant and reflect the customer’s preferences.
*Review your assessments for accuracy and consistency

Project Details

Start Date: Immediately after completing the qualification process.
Duration: Ongoing
Schedule: 5 -15 hours weekly; set your own schedule.
This is a freelance opportunity; the workload is based on project needs. Weekly hours may vary.
Employment Type: Freelance/Independent Contract
Location: Remote
Language: Swedish
Pay Rate: $10/hour - Based on tasks completed

By applying, you'll become part of our Freelance community, opening doors to a range of projects tailored to your skills and availability, particularly highlighting localization and linguistic expertise.

Payment rates for future projects may vary, ensuring fair compensation that reflects your location, industry, and skill set.

Joining us means contributing to our current project and becoming part of our dynamic network.

This is a unique chance to enhance global user experiences and apply your language skills in meaningful ways.

extra.description_html:
Welo Data is an award-winning localization and data transformation company. We run one of the world’s largest Ads Rating Programs and we want you to join! 
 
As an Ads Quality Rater, you will review and grade internet advertisements to help shape how ads are delivered to the end users. In other words, you’ll tell the AI program how good or bad its advertisement suggestions are based on the user’s keywords.
 
You will review ads in both English and Filipino
 
This role is great for people who: 
 
- Surf the internet daily 
- Use major search engines frequently 
- Know what people want based on a few keywords 
- Enjoy researching topics online
- Want a flexible and fun side job

Project Details  
 
Job Title: Ads Quality Rater
Pay Rate: Based on tasks (approximately $4 per hour)
Location: Remote/work from home - must be based in the Philippines
Hours: Set your schedule based on the following – Minimum commitment is 5 hours per week. You can choose to work up to 20 hours per week.
Start Date: ASAP
Employment Type: Independent Contractor/Freelance/Self-Employed 
Project Duration: Long-term

Note:
- Even though the position is WFH, you must reside in the country that is noted in this description. This will be automatically checked during the hiring process.

Recruitment Process
 
- There is no formal interview for this job! No phone calls, no waiting, and no wasting time wondering whether you got the job or not.
 
- Instead, you will be guided through a self-paced and automated recruitment process.
 
IMPORTANT NOTE: Welo Data uses numerous identity checks to ensure that everyone who makes the team is real, qualified, and ready to work. To avoid any misunderstandings, do not use IP masking programs (such as VPNs).
