About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Portuguese (from Portugal) speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Portuguese (from Portugal) speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Portuguese (from Portugal), and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Portuguese (from Portugal) and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the Portuguese (from Portugal) experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Portuguese (from Portugal), written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

 

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

If you're a native-level Portuguese (from Portugal) speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

Role Overview

Welocalize is hiring part-time Linguistic QA Testers with native-level British English. Are you tech-savvy, with a sharp eye for detail and a love of language? Then this is for you.

You’ll be an important part of the QA process for emerging technology. Depending on the project, you could be testing never-before-seen apps and technology, e-courses, marketing materials, or whatever interesting task comes your way. Your work helps make sure products sound natural, look right, and work properly for British English speakers.

As a QA Linguistic Tester, you’ll mainly proofread and edit content that has already been localized into British English, catching anything that doesn’t feel right, such as:

  • Grammar, typos, and syntax issues
  • Punctuation and capitalization errors
  • Culturally or politically sensitive wording
  • Inconsistencies and stray extra spaces
  • US-style spellings or phrasing that don’t belong in British English

You’ll also test user interfaces for functional issues, and occasionally adapt content from English into British English.

Main Responsibilities

  • Test a variety of products, from apps and software to e-courses and marketing materials, by carefully following test instructions and test cases
  • Find, write up, and report bugs and errors using best practices in client-specific bug tracking tools and our internal database system
  • Evaluate language in the context of software, mobile apps, and documentation
  • Act as the go-to expert for British English linguistic questions, researching and resolving issues as they arise
  • Follow project-specific quality standards, trademarks, style guides, and client-preferred checklists and glossaries
  • Troubleshoot basic problems, communicate clearly, and escalate testing issues when needed
  • Prioritize tasks and issues quickly and efficiently
  • Deliver assigned work on time and to a high standard

Job Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree from a college or university in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

Experience

  • Native-level British English fluency, spoken and written
  • Up-to-date awareness of current, common technical language usage in British English
  • Experience with Microsoft applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Comfortable navigating networks and websites across different browsers
  • Basic knowledge of PC hardware (desktop and laptop) and smartphones (iPhone or Android)
  • Flexibility to work onsite and/or remotely, depending on your location

Skills & Experience

What you bring

  • Native British English skills and strong cultural awareness of the UK
  • Good oral and written communication
  • A highly organized approach, with attention to detail and a real commitment to quality
  • Tech-savviness and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

Nice to have

  • Localization, QA, or translation experience
  • Advanced computer skills

What will help you shine

  • Strong awareness of our company and industry
  • The ability to establish and develop processes and procedures as part of a client program
  • Sharp problem-solving skills, so you can find the best solution
  • Excellent time management
  • A Plan-Do-Check-Act approach to tasks and workloads
  • Ownership of your deliverables, from start to finish

text:

While this role is more execution-focused than evaluation-heavy roles, it still requires strong judgment, attention to detail, and consistency. The work sits at the intersection of language, data, and AI systems — where precision and discipline matter at scale.
We’re looking for people who are dependable, focused, and take pride in producing high-quality work, even across repetitive workflows.

About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Russian speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Russian speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Russian, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Russian and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the Russian experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Russian , written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

 

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

If you're a native-level Russian speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

Job Description Summary
 

In this exciting position, the Multimedia Content Reviewer will be responsible for writing, adapting, reviewing, and evaluating a wide range of linguistic and multimedia content in Brazilian Portuguese, ensuring the highest standards of linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and overall quality for customers using the world's foremost multimedia platforms. 

The role combines creative and editorial expertise with analytical and quality evaluation skills, covering traditional localization work as well as emerging content types, including AI-generated content, linguistic annotation, and structured content evaluations. 

With time, the Multimedia Content Reviewer will become the cultural ambassador for their language market and will be expected to produce fully localized content, flag potential cultural issues, and articulate suggestions to make all content appropriate and relevant for the target market. 

The ideal candidate possesses a background in journalism, editorial content, copywriting, or a related field, has proven creative writing skills, and a keen attention to detail. They should also demonstrate strong critical thinking, sound editorial judgment, and the flexibility to navigate different workflows, guidelines, and content evaluation methodologies. 

In addition, we're seeking candidates who are passionate about music, film, sports, gaming, and technology, and have a knack for iOS and macOS devices.

lists.content:
• Localize, translate, and adapt content of various categories (i.e. multimedia, legal, technical, marketing, sports, entertainment, health and wellness, and other digital content) while adhering to writing style guides and project-specific guidelines. 

  • Write new copy for a range of multimedia products such as music, TV, film, sports, apps, video on-demand, game subscription services, and more. 

  • Copy-edit and fact-check content to ensure accuracy, clarity, consistency, and cultural relevance. 

  • Perform LQA (Localization QA) testing of content published on live platforms (music and app descriptions, marketing material, and marketing campaigns). 

  • Evaluate human-written and AI-generated content for linguistic accuracy, fluency, relevance, consistency, and adherence to project-specific quality standards. 

  • Perform linguistic annotation, content classification, and structured evaluation tasks using predefined guidelines, rating scales, and quality criteria. 

  • Identify and document errors, inconsistencies, and quality issues, providing clear, actionable feedback and supporting rationale for evaluation decisions. 

  • Conduct market-specific research on local content treatment, audience preferences, cultural nuances, product and terminology trends, and best localization practices for the target audience. 

  • Report on data and/or assets across a broad scope of media and content types, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with project requirements. 

  • Collaborate with global language teams via virtual meetings and email on content review tasks to align on terminology, style, quality standards, evaluation criteria, and market-specific insights.

• BS/BA and 2+ years of work experience in journalism, copywriting, editing, digital media, content production, or a related field. 

  • Experience in translation and localization of multimedia content or demonstrated experience adapting content for Brazilian audiences. 

  • Native-level proficiency in Brazilian Portuguese, with excellent grammar, writing, editing, and linguistic judgment skills. 

  • Ability to quickly detect issues and inconsistencies across large volumes of content and make sound judgment calls based on the information at hand. 

  • Ability to interpret and consistently apply detailed guidelines, rating scales, and evaluation frameworks across different projects. 

  • Familiarity with AI-generated content, linguistic annotation, content evaluation, or data quality assessment is a plus. 

  • Is in tune with and has a wide range of knowledge of music, film, TV, sports, gaming, technology, and Brazilian pop culture. 

  • Has the ability to own linguistic quality for the Brazilian Portuguese market and make confident linguistic decisions. 

  • Must be highly detail-oriented with the ability to multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines. 

  • Fluency in written and verbal English. 

  • Strong computer literacy; knowledge of iOS/macOS systems is a plus. 

  • Ability to work independently and remotely. 

  • Collaborative; enjoys teamwork in a multicultural environment and is open to feedback, calibration, and continuous learning.

About Welo Life Sciences 

Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications.  welolifesciences.com

About the Role

We are currently looking for freelance professionals to support Non-Linguistic QC activities for our translation projects in the Life Sciences domain.

Non-Linguistic QC is the final quality assurance step before delivery to the client. Typical tasks include checking for inconsistencies, numeric mismatches, formatting and layout issues, and ensuring client-specific requirements have been followed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform Non-Linguistic Quality Control of translations into English for pharmacovigilance, regulatory, and clinical content.
  • Use CAT tools and run QC checks to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Validate formatting, numbers, dates, units, terminology, and adherence to instructions.
  • Support processing of non-editable/handwritten sources and perform formatting QC after conversion.
  • Work according to availability and meet TATs (typically 12–24 hours).

Requirements

QC/QA Experience
  • Minimum 6 months QC/QA-related experience in the localization industry. *Project management experience involving pre-delivery checks can also be counted.

Technical Skills

  • Familiarity with CAT tools (XTM/Phrase), License will be provided.
  • Familiarity with QA checks tools (Xbench, Verifika, or CAT-integrated QA)
  • Familiarity with Track Changes in Microsoft Word
English Proficiency
  • Advanced level in English (C1 or above)
Availability
  • Availability of 4–5 hours per day
  • Flexibility and willingness to work occasional weekends and bank holidays.
  • Able to meet urgent TATs (12–24 hours) and manage many small files.

Before Applying

Please note there will be an assessment as part of our onboarding and quality procedure, please only apply if you're willing to complete our assessment.
 
Please ensure your latest English CV accurately reflects your QC related experience, including years of experience, the document types you’ve QCd, CAT tool you've used, and relevant details also your contact information (email AND phone number).
 
Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global
 
We look forward to receiving your application!
 
Job Reference: #LI-JC1

About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Japanese speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Japanese, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Japanese and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the Japanese experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Japanese, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

 

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

If you're a native-level Japanese speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

About the Role 

We are looking for a detail-oriented QC Reviewer to ensure the quality and consistency of robot manipulation video annotations produced by our annotation team. You'll review labeled video segments against a detailed style guide and reference examples, catch errors or inconsistencies, and provide clear, constructive feedback to annotators. This role is critical to maintaining the accuracy and reliability of training data used for robotics AI models. 

What You'll Do 

    - Review completed annotations of robot manipulation videos across three levels of labeling detail (atomic motion, skill/subtask, task/goal). 

    - Cross-check annotator descriptions against all three camera views (overhead and both wrist-mounted cameras) to verify accuracy of described actions, object identification, and contact/grasp details. 

    - Verify full coverage of each video — confirm there are no gaps in labeling, including idle or pause moments. 

    - Check that descriptions accurately reflect what actually happened in the video, including failures, drops, or slipped grips — flagging any instances where outcomes were inaccurately described or "smoothed over." 

    - Evaluate annotations for adherence to the style guide: correct vocabulary usage, spatial/directional accuracy, consistent terminology for objects and actions, and appropriate language variation (avoiding repetitive phrasing). 

    - Identify recurring errors or patterns of confusion among annotators and report them to the team lead for calibration purposes. 

    - Provide specific, actionable feedback on rejected or revised annotations, referencing the style guide and reference examples. 

    - Participate in periodic calibration sessions with the team and client to align QC standards with evolving guidelines or edge-case resolutions. 

    - Maintain a QC log or tracking sheet documenting review outcomes, common error types, and annotator performance trends (as required by the project). 

 

What We're Looking For 

Required: 

    - Excellent written English and strong reading comprehension — you'll be evaluating precise, nuanced language choices, not just checking for typos. 

    - Exceptional attention to detail — able to catch subtle mismatches between video content and written description (e.g., a mislabeled grasp type, an incorrect object part, a missed failure event). 

    - Strong grasp of spatial/mechanical description (left/right, above/below, object parts like handles, lids, edges) to verify annotator accuracy. 

    - Ability to apply a detailed, structured style guide consistently and make sound judgment calls in ambiguous or edge-case scenarios. 

    - Comfort giving clear, specific, and constructive feedback to annotators (written feedback, not just pass/fail marks). 

    - Reliable, self-directed work habits, with the ability to work independently while meeting review turnaround expectations. 

Nice to Have: 

    - Prior experience in a QC, editing, proofreading, or annotation review role. 

    - Experience with video annotation, data labeling, or transcription QA specifically. 

    - Familiarity with robotics terminology (grippers, end-effectors, manipulation). 

    - Experience with annotation tools such as Label Studio, including review/approval workflows. 

#L1-CC1

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Italian speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programe for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in Italian, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model outputs in Italian and evaluate them for accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality—would a native speaker say it this way? Fact-check each response against the provided source material. 

  • Test the Italian experience against English: confirm feature parity, complete an end-to-end user journey using non-English input, and verify that the product correctly handles non-Latin scripts, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input.

  • Identify any display issues (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering poorly) and any localization errors—incorrect dates, numbers, currencies, units, or untranslated strings.

  • Document each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it—include steps taken, device and OS, locale, build ID, and supporting evidence. Retest after a fix ships to confirm it’s resolved.

  • Provide native-level insights on navigation and usability, calling out Italian-specific nuances that only a fluent speaker would notice.

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office; due to the confidential, pre-release nature of the work, remote or work-from-home options are not available.

  • Assist with other linguistic projects as needed.

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual proficiency in Italian, written and spoken, with an up-to-date sense of real-world usage across both everyday and technical contexts.

  • Confident using smartphones and laptops; comfortable working across both iOS and Android.

  • Strong attention to detail and fair, objective judgment when assessing quality.

  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed test scripts and guidelines, and clearly explain issues in English.

  • Previous experience in software/app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus, but not required if you bring the language skills and attention to detail.

 

Welocalize helps the world’s leading brands reach global audiences—and language testing is at the core of that mission. You’ll work alongside experienced linguists and testers on pre-release technology, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously.

If you’re a native-level Italian speaker with a keen eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology intersect, we’d like to hear from you.

text:
Overview
Welo Data is looking for sharp, curious, and detail-oriented individuals to join our team as Data Labeling Associate.
This is not a traditional annotation role.
You’ll be working directly with cutting-edge AI systems — evaluating outputs, identifying gaps, and helping improve how these systems behave in real-world scenarios. The work sits at the intersection of data quality, model evaluation, and human judgment, where your ability to think critically matters just as much as following guidelines.
We’re looking for people who are naturally curious about AI, comfortable forming opinions, and confident in contributing to conversations with teammates, leads, and stakeholders.

Hiring in: Onsite (Bay Area, Seattle, NYC, or client-dependent)

- Contribute to improving evaluation frameworks, not just executing them

- Identify trends in model performance and communicate insights clearly

- Participate in team discussions, calibrations, and stakeholder syncs

- Partner with leads and cross-functional teams to refine quality standards

- Document findings in a clear, concise, and actionable way

- Ability to apply complex writing rules and guidelines consistently

- Strong critical thinking and attention to detail

- Naturally curious about AI, technology, and how systems behave

- Comfortable speaking up, asking questions, and contributing ideas

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Ability to stay consistent while working with evolving guidelines

- Experience in data quality, QA, annotation, or analysis is helpful — but not required

About the Role

Welo Data is seeking experienced linguists to support a synthetic data generation program for a leading technology client. In this role, you will perform A/B preference testing of machine-generated translations from English into Indic languages, helping to evaluate and improve the quality of AI-generated content. 

As a Translation Validator, you will independently review an English source document alongside two machine-generated translations (Variant A and Variant B), select the preferred translation, and provide a written justification for your choice. Each sample is reviewed by three independent validators working in a blind process.

Project Details

  • Job Title: Translation Validation - Assamese
  • Location: Remote 
  • Employment Type: Freelance Contract 

What You’ll Do

  • Review English source documents alongside two machine-generated Assamese translations.
  • Evaluate both variants based on accuracy, fluency, and overall translation quality.
  • Select the preferred translation and provide a clear written justification for your assessment.
  • Review audio files and their corresponding transcriptions, evaluating accuracy, completeness, and overall quality.
  • Assess both transcription quality and audio quality according to project guidelines.
  • Complete assigned samples independently and within established timelines.
  • Adhere strictly to project and client guidelines

Requirements:

  • Native-level fluency in Assamese (written and spoken).
  • Strong written communication skills in the target language.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Background in linguistics, translation, or language quality assessment preferred.
  • Ability to work independently with high attention to detail and consistency.
  • Familiarity with Romanized script conventions for the relevant language is a plus (for transliteration tasks).
Why Join Welo Data?  
✨ Limitless Flexibility  
Project-based opportunities that fit your availability. Choose when and how much you want to contribute—fully remote, with complete autonomy.   
🌱 Limitless Growth  
Optional access to AI and Large Language Model workshops designed specifically for professionals like you. No coding required—just your expertise.   
🌍 Limitless Support  
Be part of a global contributor community with responsive guidance and support.   
💡 Real Impact  
Apply your expertise in the Legal field to influence the AI systems shaping the future of your industry—while collaborating with data professionals and expanding your skills.

About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Vietnamese speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Vietnamese speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Vietnamese, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Vietnamese and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the Vietnamese experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Vietnamese, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

 

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

If you're a native-level Vietnamese speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

MAIN PURPOSE OF JOB
 
In this exciting position, the Hebrew Multimedia Content Reviewer will be writing and reviewing linguistic content in a language which they have a native level proficiency to ensure the highest quality of accuracy for customers using the world's foremost multimedia platforms. With time the Multimedia Content Reviewer will become the cultural ambassador for their language market and will be expected to produce fully localized content and flag potential cultural issues with content types, wording and articulate suggestions to make all content appropriate and relevant for the target markets. 
 
The ideal candidate possesses a background in journalism or similar, has proven creative writing skills, and a keen attention to detail. In addition to that, we’re seeking candidates that are passionate about music, film and tech and have a knack for iOS and Mac OS devices.

lists.content:
The following is a non-exhaustive list of responsibilities and areas of ownership of the Multimedia Content Reviewer:

  • Localize, translate and adapt content of various categories (such as music, film, gaming and sports content) while adhering to writing style guide and guidelines

  • Write new copy for a range of multimedia products and services

  • Perform annotation tasks

  • Perform regular linguistic review of their own work as well as the work performed by other members of the localization team for all content types

  • Copy-edit and fact check content to ensure accuracy of content

  • Perform LQA (Localization QA) testing of any content published on live platforms (music and app descriptions, marketing material and marketing campaigns)

  • Conduct market-specific research on local content, product and terminology trends and best localization practices for the target audience in their market

  • Transcribe spoken content such as lyrics

  • Report on data and/or assets across a broad scope of media and content types

  • Review linguistic assessments, create training material and documents for new projects and ensure that other counterparts of the localization team are fully trained on terminology, style and best practices 

  • Collaborate with the global language team via virtual meetings, emails on content review tasks to ensure calibrating terminology and style, understanding trends and market specific insights, translations based on the market team's needs

    •

• BS/BA and 2+ years of work experience in the field of journalism, copywriting, or copyediting media content such as music, TV and applications with proof of writing samples

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Hebrew, written and spoken

  • Experience in translation and localization of multimedia content

  • Creative writer

  • Ability to quickly detect issues and inconsistencies from a massive sea of content and make sound judgement calls based on information at hand

  • Is in tune and has a wide range of knowledge regarding music artists, TV and cinema, gaming and pop culture

  • Has the ability to own the language market and make confident linguistic decisions

  • Must be highly detail-oriented with the ability to multitask, prioritize and meet deadlines

  • Fluency in written and verbal English

  • Strong computer literacy; knowledge of iOS/macOS systems is a plus 

  • Well capable of typing in their native level language using a local (English) keyboard

  • Ability to work independently and remotely

  • Collaborative; enjoys teamwork in a multicultural environment

JOB OVERVIEW

As a Linguist, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality localization services, including translation, post-editing, proofreading, and linguistic review activities across various projects. Your focus will be on producing natural, accurate, and culturally appropriate content in Hindi while ensuring alignment with the source text's intent, tone, and communication objectives.

You will work on a diverse range of content types, such as marketing, user interface strings, legal documentation, training materials, presentations, and multimedia assets. The role requires strong linguistic judgment to adapt content effectively for the target audience while maintaining consistency, quality, and adherence to client-specific guidelines. Depending on project needs, you may also be involved in content creation, transcreation, and terminology management.

Success in this role requires excellent command of both English and Hindi, strong attention to detail, and the ability to balance linguistic accuracy with audience engagement. Familiarity with CAT tools, localization workflows, and quality assurance processes is essential. The ideal candidate demonstrates ownership, effective communication skills, adaptability, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced environment.

The following is a non-exhaustive list of responsibilities and areas of ownership for this role:

MAIN DUTIES

Perform translation, post-editing, copy-editing, and proofreading tasks between English and Hindi using designated translation and localization tools.

Handle a wide range of content types, including marketing materials, UI strings, creative content, legal content, and other localized assets, adapting the level of creativity as required.

Review and understand project requirements, target audience expectations, and machine translation (MT) quality before starting assignments.

Effectively utilize CAT tools and other supporting platforms required for localization work, such as query management systems and UI review tools.

Adhere to established workflows and processes, including raising queries, reporting issues, and proactively communicating risks or blockers to relevant stakeholders.

Ensure compliance with client-specific style guides, terminology databases, linguistic standards, and quality requirements.

Continuously improve performance by incorporating feedback received through internal and external quality evaluations.

Monitor personal quality metrics and error trends, and actively work on identified improvement areas.

Participate in internal training sessions, knowledge-sharing initiatives, and client-led training programs.

Contribute to error review and arbitration discussions to support quality improvement and consistency.

Meet defined productivity, quality, and turnaround-time targets.

Attend internal quality meetings and client quality review calls, contributing constructively to discussions and action plans.

Demonstrate a growth mindset by regularly assessing skill gaps and seeking guidance from language leads and management to enhance performance and professional development.

REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor’s degree in Translation, Applied Languages, Linguistics, Literature, Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred.

Native or near-native proficiency in Hindi and strong command of English.

Experience or demonstrated interest in creative localization, translation, transcreation, copywriting, content writing, or Hindi content creation. Exposure to blogging, video scripts, voice-over scripts, web content, marketing communications, magazines, newspapers, or digital media content is an advantage. Fresh graduates with exceptional language skills and a passion for creative writing are encouraged to apply.

Strong comprehension skills in English with the ability to accurately translate, transcreate, post-edit, copy-edit, and proofread content according to client requirements and target audience needs.

Excellent written Hindi with a keen eye for grammar, style, consistency, and linguistic accuracy.

Ability to identify, analyze, and resolve linguistic, terminology, and localization-related issues.

Familiarity with CAT tools and localization workflows; experience with industry-standard localization platforms is a plus.

Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Detail-oriented mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality, error-free work.

Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and openness to constructive feedback.

Ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment while managing individual responsibilities.

Education

extra.description_html:
About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Malayalam speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Malayalam speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Malayalam, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Malayalam and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the Malayalam experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Malayalam, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

 

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

If you're a native-level Malayalam speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Bengali speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Bengali speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Bengali, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Bengali and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the Bengali experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Bengali, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

 

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

If you're a native-level Bengali speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

extra.description_html:
About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Romanian speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Romanian speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Romanian, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Romanian and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the Romanian experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Romanian, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

 

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

If you're a native-level Romanian speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Swahili speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Swahili speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Swahili, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Swahili and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the Swahili experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Swahili, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

 

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

If you're a native-level Swahili speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

About Welo Life Sciences 

Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications.  welolifesciences.com

About the Role

We are looking for experienced French (France) to English (GB and US) linguists to support a high-volume, fast-turnaround pharmacovigilance program for a leading global pharmaceutical company. Work involves translating and reviewing safety and regulatory content, including adverse event reports and related clinical documentation, with strict turnaround times and deadlines. 

This is an ongoing freelance engagement with daily volumes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate pharmacovigilance and/or clinical-regulatory content from French into English.
  • Perform Machine Translation Post-Editing (MTPE) on machine-translated safety content.
  • Perform Copy Edit review of translated/post-edited content for accuracy, tone, and consistency.
  • Meet strict, non-extendable turnaround times on time-sensitive safety content.
  • Occasionally support Transcription tasks, retyping scanned or handwritten PDFs into Word for downstream translation (requires a personal Gmail account for client platform access).
  • Work within the client's CAT tool environment (XTM) following project-specific setup instructions.

Requirements

  • Degree in translation, linguistics or languages studies or an equivalent degree that includes significant 
    translation training.
  • Minimum 2 years of professional experience translating Life Sciences documents.
  • Experience translating pharmacovigilance content preferred: SAE/AE (serious and non-serious adverse events), PSURs, SUSARs, ICSRs, DSURs, Risk Management Plans (RMP).
  • Alternatively, experience translating regulatory or clinical documents: medical reports, protocols, synopses, ICF, discharge reports, study reports, SmPC, PIL, or medical literature.
  • Great daily availability: this program requires consistent daily capacity and is not suited to part-time schedules.
  • Strong French proficiency; native level of English preferred but not mandatory.
  • Experience with XTM or similar CAT tools.
  • Reliable, deadline-driven, and flexible, able to commit to fast turnaround times with no extensions.

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare professional (HCP) background: nurse or physician preferred, especially with emergency room experience. Other HCP backgrounds also welcome.
  • Availability to cover US business hours.
  • Willingness to commit to daily and/or weekend availability.

Tools & Systems

  • CAT tool: XTM, client-provided license; onboarding and connector setup provided after onboarding.
  • A personal Gmail account is required for linguists supporting Transcription tasks, for access to a client platform.

All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications.  welolifesciences.com
About the Role
We are looking for experienced French (France) to English (GB and US) linguists to support a high-volume, fast-turnaround pharmacovigilance program for a leading global pharmaceutical company. Work involves translating and reviewing safety and regulatory content, including adverse event reports and related clinical documentation, with strict turnaround times and deadlines. 
This is an ongoing freelance engagement with daily volumes.
Key Responsibilities
Translate pharmacovigilance and/or clinical-regulatory content from French into English.
Perform Machine Translation Post-Editing (MTPE) on machine-translated safety content.
Perform Copy Edit review of translated/post-edited content for accuracy, tone, and consistency.
Meet strict, non-extendable turnaround times on time-sensitive safety content.
Occasionally support Transcription tasks, retyping scanned or handwritten PDFs into Word for downstream translation (requires a personal Gmail account for client platform access).
Work within the client's CAT tool environment (XTM) following project-specific setup instructions.
Requirements
Degree in translation, linguistics or languages studies or an equivalent degree that includes significant 
translation training.
Minimum 2 years of professional experience translating Life Sciences documents.
Experience translating pharmacovigilance content preferred: SAE/AE (serious and non-serious adverse events), PSURs, SUSARs, ICSRs, DSURs, Risk Management Plans (RMP).
Alternatively, experience translating regulatory or clinical documents: medical reports, protocols, synopses, ICF, discharge reports, study reports, SmPC, PIL, or medical literature.
Great daily availability: this program requires consistent daily capacity and is not suited to part-time schedules.
Strong French proficiency; native level of English preferred but not mandatory.
Experience with XTM or similar CAT tools.
Reliable, deadline-driven, and flexible, able to commit to fast turnaround times with no extensions.
Nice to Have
Healthcare professional (HCP) background: nurse or physician preferred, especially with emergency room experience. Other HCP backgrounds also welcome.
Availability to cover US business hours.
Willingness to commit to daily and/or weekend availability.
Tools & Systems
CAT tool: XTM, client-provided license; onboarding and connector setup provided after onboarding.
A personal Gmail account is required for linguists supporting Transcription tasks, for access to a client platform.

Before Applying
Please note there will be an assessment as part of our onboarding and quality procedure, please only apply if you're willing to complete our assessment.
 
Please ensure your latest English CV accurately reflects your Life Sciences and Medical translation experience, including years of experience specifically in Life Sciences, the document types you’ve translated, CAT tool you've used, and relevant details also your contact information (email AND phone number).
 
Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global
 
We look forward to receiving your application!

extra.description_html:
Overview

We’re hiring data collection operators to support physical AI programs. In this role, you’ll operate physical AI data collection systems (via teleoperation tools or guided interfaces) to generate high-quality real-world data used to train and evaluate AI models.

This is hands-on, execution-focused work. You’ll be supporting a robotics data collection pilot using I2RT YAM bimanual robotic arms. Each station is staffed by two people, and you’ll carry out assigned teleoperation and human-robot interaction tasks to help capture reliable, consistent data. 

Project Details

  • Location: Palo Alto, CA — 100% onsite
  • Type: Full-time, short-term W-2 employee
  • Schedule: Full-time; 8 hours/day, 5 days/week. Must be able to stand for extended periods during shifts 
  • Duration: Minimum 2-week engagement; potential extension through year-end and beyond (extension not guaranteed) 
  • Start: ASAP
  • Compensation: US$35/hour
  • Work authorization: Must be authorized to work onsite in the U.S.

lists.content:
• Operate physical AI data devices, including teleoperating bimanual robotic arms (I2RT YAM) to execute scripted tasks precisely, following SOPs.
  • Perform human robot interaction tasks per script, including gestures and object handovers.
  • Follow detailed instructions and documented SOPs, adapt to evolving guidelines, and complete hands-on training, applying it consistently.
  • Coordinate closely with your station partner to maintain timing, consistency, and safety.
  • Capture and validate data. Record trial status, notes, and anomalies as directed; promptly flag issues and assist with resets/retries.
  • Adhere to onsite safety, privacy, and data handling protocols; provide constructive feedback to improve procedures.
  • Support fast iteration cycles as tasks, tools, and priorities evolve.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience 
  • Experience with gaming, simulation tools, or technical systems is a plus
  • Strong hand-eye coordination and spatial awareness
  • Detail oriented, reliable, and consistent in repetitive, process-driven work.
  • Clear communication and teamwork; receptive to coaching and feedback.
  • Prior teleoperation/robotics or lab data collection experience preferred; training provided.
  • Basic computer skills for simple logging and spreadsheets.
    •  

    Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to robotics, autonomous systems, drones, or simulation environments
  • Experience with teleoperation, remote control systems, or QA/testing workflows
