Overview
We’re hiring data collection operators to support physical AI programs. In this role, you’ll operate physical AI data collection systems (via teleoperation tools or guided interfaces) to generate high-quality real-world data used to train and evaluate AI models.
This is hands-on, execution-focused work. You’ll be supporting a robotics data collection pilot using I2RT YAM bimanual robotic arms. Each station is staffed by two people, and you’ll carry out assigned teleoperation and human-robot interaction tasks to help capture reliable, consistent data. 
Project Details
Location: Palo Alto, CA — 100% onsite
Type: Full-time, short-term W-2 employee
Schedule: Full-time; 8 hours/day, 5 days/week. Must be able to stand for extended periods during shifts 
Duration: Minimum 2-week engagement; potential extension through year-end and beyond (extension not guaranteed) 
Start: ASAP
Compensation: US$35/hour
Work authorization: Must be authorized to work onsite in the U.S.

Key responsibilities
- Operate physical AI data devices, including teleoperating bimanual robotic arms (I2RT YAM) to execute scripted tasks precisely, following SOPs.

- Perform human robot interaction tasks per script, including gestures and object handovers.

- Follow detailed instructions and documented SOPs, adapt to evolving guidelines, and complete hands-on training, applying it consistently.

- Coordinate closely with your station partner to maintain timing, consistency, and safety.

- Capture and validate data. Record trial status, notes, and anomalies as directed; promptly flag issues and assist with resets/retries.

- Adhere to onsite safety, privacy, and data handling protocols; provide constructive feedback to improve procedures.

- Support fast iteration cycles as tasks, tools, and priorities evolve.

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

- Experience with gaming, simulation tools, or technical systems is a plus

- Strong hand-eye coordination and spatial awareness

- Detail oriented, reliable, and consistent in repetitive, process-driven work.

- Clear communication and teamwork; receptive to coaching and feedback.

- Prior teleoperation/robotics or lab data collection experience preferred; training provided.

- Basic computer skills for simple logging and spreadsheets.

### Preferred Qualifications

- Exposure to robotics, autonomous systems, drones, or simulation environments

- Experience with teleoperation, remote control systems, or QA/testing workflows

- Familiarity with data collection, logging, or annotation processes

- Ability to quickly learn new software applications

- Interest in AI, robotics, or emerging technologies

- Experience working in structured, metrics-driven environments

Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.

At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech?
 
Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI.
 
By joining our talent community, you'll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms.

As an Ads Quality Rater, you will review and grade internet advertisements to help shape how ads are delivered to the end users. In other words, you’ll tell the AI program how good or bad its advertisement suggestions are based on the user’s keywords.
 
You will review ads in both English and Mandarin
 
This role is great for people who: 
 
- Surf the internet daily 
- Use major search engines frequently 
- Know what people want based on a few keywords 
- Enjoy researching topics online
- Want a flexible and fun side job

extra.description_html:
About the Role 

We are looking for detail-oriented annotators to help label robot manipulation videos for AI training purposes. You'll watch short videos of robots performing manipulation tasks (filmed from three synchronized camera angles) and produce precise, structured, natural-language descriptions of the actions taking place. This work directly supports the development of robotics AI models and requires strong written English, sharp observational skills, and the discipline to follow a detailed style guide consistently. 

What You'll Do 

1. Watch short robot manipulation videos, each filmed from three synchronized camera views (an overhead view and views from each of the robot's two wrist-mounted cameras). 

2. Break each video into time segments and write clear, natural-language descriptions for each segment. 

3. Apply labels at three levels of detail for each applicable segment: 

- Atomic motion (a few seconds) — a single small movement (e.g., "close fingers around the red handle") 

- Skill / subtask (several seconds to ~20 seconds) — a complete, meaningful action (e.g., "pick up the red block by its edge") 

- Task / goal (up to ~1 minute) — the overall purpose of a sequence of skills (e.g., "place all blocks in the container") 

 

4. Ensure every moment of video is covered by a label at two or more of these levels — no gaps, including idle or pause moments. 

5. Accurately describe exactly what happens, including when something doesn't go as planned (a dropped object, a failed grasp, a slipped grip). Precision matters more than making the robot look successful. 

6. Cross-reference all three camera angles: use the overhead view to understand the overall scene and object identity, and the close-up wrist views to confirm exact contact and grasp details. 

7. Follow a detailed style guide covering vocabulary for actions, spatial relationships, object descriptions, and manner of movement, applying it consistently across many episodes. 

8. Participate in periodic calibration sessions to align your labeling with the team and the client's reference examples. 

 

What We're Looking For 

Required: 

1. Strong written English — you'll write dozens of short, precise descriptive sentences per video and need to vary your language rather than repeating the same phrases. 

2. Sharp attention to detail — able to distinguish small differences (a successful grasp vs. a fumble, a push vs. a drag, which specific object part is being touched). 

3. Comfort following a detailed, structured style guide and applying it consistently, even in ambiguous or edge-case scenarios. 

4. Basic comfort with spatial/mechanical description (left/right, above/below, naming object parts like handles, lids, or edges). 

5. Reliable, self-directed work habits — this is often heads-down work with periodic check-ins rather than close supervision. 

Nice to Have: 

1. Prior experience with video annotation, data labeling, transcription, or QA work. 

2. Familiarity with robotics terminology (grippers, end-effectors, manipulation) — helpful but not necessary, as the style guide is self-contained. 

3. Experience with annotation tools such as Label Studio. 

 

#L1-CC1

About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Arabic speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Arabic speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Arabic, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Arabic and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the Arabic experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Arabic, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

 

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

If you're a native-level Arabic speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

extra.description_html:
About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Gujarati speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Gujarati speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Gujarati, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Gujarati and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the Gujarati experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Gujarati, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

 

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

If you're a native-level Gujarati speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 
 
MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 
Review pre-release AI model output in Swahili and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material.

You will review ads in both English and Icelandic

This role is great for people who:

- Use major search engines frequently 
- Know what people want based on a few keywords 
- Enjoy researching topics online
- Want a flexible and fun side job

About Welo Life Sciences 

Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications.  welolifesciences.com

About the Role

We are currently looking for freelance professionals to support Non-Linguistic QC activities for our translation projects in the Life Sciences domain.

Non-Linguistic QC is the final quality assurance step before delivery to the client. Typical tasks include checking for inconsistencies, numeric mismatches, formatting and layout issues, and ensuring client-specific requirements have been followed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform Non-Linguistic Quality Control of translations into English for pharmacovigilance, regulatory, and clinical content.
  • Use CAT tools and run QC checks to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Validate formatting, numbers, dates, units, terminology, and adherence to instructions.
  • Support processing of non-editable/handwritten sources and perform formatting QC after conversion.
  • Work according to availability and meet TATs (typically 12–24 hours).

Requirements

QC/QA Experience
  • Minimum 6 months QC/QA-related experience in the localization industry. *Project management experience involving pre-delivery checks can also be counted.

Technical Skills

  • Familiarity with CAT tools (XTM/Phrase), License will be provided.
  • Familiarity with QA checks tools (Xbench, Verifika, or CAT-integrated QA)
  • Familiarity with Track Changes in Microsoft Word
English Proficiency
  • Advanced level in English (C1 or above)
Availability
  • Availability of 4–5 hours per day
  • Flexibility and willingness to work occasional weekends and bank holidays.
  • Able to meet urgent TATs (12–24 hours) and manage many small files.

Before Applying

Please note there will be an assessment as part of our onboarding and quality procedure, please only apply if you're willing to complete our assessment.
 
Please ensure your latest English CV accurately reflects your QC related experience, including years of experience, the document types you’ve QCd, CAT tool you've used, and relevant details also your contact information (email AND phone number).
 
Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global
 
We look forward to receiving your application!
 
Job Reference: #LI-JC1

extra.description_html:
About Welo Life Sciences 

Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications.  welolifesciences.com

About the Role

We are looking for experienced English into Spanish (ESUS/US based) linguists specializing in Clinical-trial, Pharmacovigilance and Regulatory document translation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate clinical research, regulatory and pharmacovigilance documents from English to Spanish LatAm.
  • Perform Machine Translation Post-Editing (MTPE) on machine-translated safety content.
  • Perform Copy Edit (translation review) of translated/post-edited content for accuracy, tone, and consistency.
  • Meet strict, non-extendable turnaround times on time-sensitive content.
  • Work within the client's CAT tool environment (XTM/Phrase), also Track Changes in Microsoft Word following project-specific setup instructions.

Field of Expertise

  • Clinical Research Documents (protocols and synopses, IB, ICF, Patient Sheets, Patient Diaries)
  • Regulatory Documents (SmPC, PIL, Labels, CTD Modules)
  • Pharmacovigilance Documents (PSUR, DSUR, RMP, SAE and AE)

Must-Have Criteria

  • Applicant must meet at least one of the following criteria:

Education

  • A degree in Translation, Linguistics, or Language Studies (or an equivalent degree) or
  • Recognized graduate qualification in any other field, plus a minimum of two years of full-time professional experience in translation or
  • A minimum of five years of full-time professional experience in translation

Relevant translation experience

  • At least two years of practical translation experience, specifically with life sciences (clinical trials and pharmacovigilance) and medical documents

Technical Skills

  • Familiarity with CAT tools (XTM/Phrase), License will be provided.
  • Familiarity with Track Changes in Microsoft Word
Native Language
  • Candidates must be native Spanish speakers who were born and raised in the U.S., or have been residing in the U.S. for at least 10 years and be able to demonstrate familiarity with the differences between the Spanish used in their country of origin and in the U.S.
Location
  • A candidate must be based in the U.S.

Nice-to-Have

  • Degree in Medicine, Biology, Biochemistry, Clinical Research, Translation, Linguistics, Philology or similar
  • In-house industry experience at a CRO or pharmaceutical company.

Before Applying

Please note there will be an assessment as part of our onboarding and quality procedure, please only apply if you're willing to complete our assessment.
 
Please ensure your latest English CV accurately reflects your Life Sciences and Medical translation experience, including years of experience specifically in Life Sciences, the document types you’ve translated, CAT tool you've used, and relevant details also your contact information (email AND phone number).
 
Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global
 
We look forward to receiving your application!

Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.

At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech?
 
Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI.
 
By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms.
 
Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation.
 
What You’ll Need
- Native or near-native fluency in Punjabi
- Based in: India
- English proficiency
- Comfortable with digital tools
- Detail-oriented and curious
 
Why Join Us?
🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow
🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI
🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community
 
About our projects:
Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.
Depending on your skills, you might:
📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems
🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance
💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs)
🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy
Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you.
 
How to Apply?
Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community.
 
📬Questions?
If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.

Welo Data is looking for experienced, detail-oriented professionals to join our team as Data Quality Analysts. This role sits at the center of execution and quality — bridging Data Labeling Associates (DLAs) and Team Leads to ensure work is not only completed, but done right.

You'll work closely with both people and AI systems — auditing outputs, supporting day-to-day execution, and helping teams apply guidelines correctly in fast-moving, real-world scenarios. The work combines data quality, light project coordination, and hands-on training, where your ability to guide others and think critically is just as important as your own output.

Project Details

  • Job Title: Data Quality Analyst
  • Hiring in: Onsite (Bay Area, Seattle, NYC, or client-dependent) 
  • Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week
  • Employment Type: W2 Full-Time Employee
  • Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. (no visa sponsorship)
  • Pay Rate: $38/hour
 
Important: This is a 100% onsite position — remote work is not available for this role. To be considered, candidates must be located in or able to commute to one of the following cities: NYC, Seattle, Bellevue, Redmond, San Francisco, Sunnyvale, Burlingame, Austin, Los Angeles, Washington DC, Chicago, Boston, Austin. Please only apply if you meet this location requirement.

extra.description_html:
About Welo Life Sciences 

Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications.  welolifesciences.com

About the Role

We are looking for experienced Spanish (Spain) to English (GB or US) linguists to support a high-volume, fast-turnaround pharmacovigilance program for a leading global pharmaceutical company. Work involves translating and reviewing safety and regulatory content, including adverse event reports and related clinical documentation, with strict turnaround times and deadlines. 

This is an ongoing freelance engagement with daily volumes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate Pharmacovigilance and/or Clinical-regulatory content from Spanish into English.
  • Perform Machine Translation Post-Editing (MTPE) on machine-translated safety content.
  • Perform Copy Edit review of translated/post-edited content for accuracy, tone, and consistency.
  • Meet strict, non-extendable turnaround times on time-sensitive safety content.

Requirements

  • Degree in translation, linguistics or languages studies or an equivalent degree that includes significant 
    translation training.
  • Minimum 2 years of professional experience translating medical documentation, specificially with experience and knowledge in Pharmacovigilance and/or Clinical-Regulatory content.
  • Experience translating pharmacovigilance content preferred: SAE/AE (serious and non-serious adverse events), PSURs, SUSARs, ICSRs, DSURs, Risk Management Plans (RMP).
  • Alternatively, experience translating regulatory or clinical documents: medical reports, protocols, synopses, ICF, discharge reports, study reports, SmPC, PIL, or medical literature.
  • Great daily availability: this program requires consistent daily capacity and is not suited to part-time schedules.
  • Strong Spanish proficiency; native level of English preferred but not mandatory.
  • Experience with XTM or similar CAT tools.
  • Reliable, deadline-driven, and flexible, able to commit to fast turnaround times with no extensions.

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare professional (HCP) background: nurse or physician preferred, especially with emergency room experience. Other HCP backgrounds also welcome.
  • Willingness to commit to daily and/or weekend availability.

Tools & Systems

  • CAT tool: XTM, client-provided license; onboarding and connector setup provided after onboarding.

Before Applying

Please note there will be an assessment as part of our onboarding and quality procedure, please only apply if you're willing to complete our assessment.
 
Please ensure your latest English CV accurately reflects your Life Sciences and Medical translation experience, including years of experience specifically in Life Sciences, the document types you’ve translated, CAT tool you've used, and relevant details also your contact information (email AND phone number).
 
Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global
 
We look forward to receiving your application!
 
Job Reference: #LI-JC1

Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications.  welolifesciences.com
About the Role
We are looking for experienced Spanish (Spain) to English (GB or US) linguists to support a high-volume, fast-turnaround pharmacovigilance program for a leading global pharmaceutical company. Work involves translating and reviewing safety and regulatory content, including adverse event reports and related clinical documentation, with strict turnaround times and deadlines. 
This is an ongoing freelance engagement with daily volumes.
Key Responsibilities
Translate Pharmacovigilance and/or Clinical-regulatory content from Spanish into English.
Perform Machine Translation Post-Editing (MTPE) on machine-translated safety content.
Perform Copy Edit review of translated/post-edited content for accuracy, tone, and consistency.
Meet strict, non-extendable turnaround times on time-sensitive safety content.
Requirements
Degree in translation, linguistics or languages studies or an equivalent degree that includes significant 
translation training.
Minimum 2 years of professional experience translating medical documentation, specificially with experience and knowledge in Pharmacovigilance and/or Clinical-Regulatory content.
Experience translating pharmacovigilance content preferred: SAE/AE (serious and non-serious adverse events), PSURs, SUSARs, ICSRs, DSURs, Risk Management Plans (RMP).
Alternatively, experience translating regulatory or clinical documents: medical reports, protocols, synopses, ICF, discharge reports, study reports, SmPC, PIL, or medical literature.
Great daily availability: this program requires consistent daily capacity and is not suited to part-time schedules.
Strong Spanish proficiency; native level of English preferred but not mandatory.
Experience with XTM or similar CAT tools.
Reliable, deadline-driven, and flexible, able to commit to fast turnaround times with no extensions.
Nice to Have
Healthcare professional (HCP) background: nurse or physician preferred, especially with emergency room experience. Other HCP backgrounds also welcome.
Willingness to commit to daily and/or weekend availability.
Tools & Systems
CAT tool: XTM, client-provided license; onboarding and connector setup provided after onboarding.
Before Applying
Please note there will be an assessment as part of our onboarding and quality procedure, please only apply if you're willing to complete our assessment.
 
Please ensure your latest English CV accurately reflects your Life Sciences and Medical translation experience, including years of experience specifically in Life Sciences, the document types you’ve translated, CAT tool you've used, and relevant details also your contact information (email AND phone number).
 
Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global
 
We look forward to receiving your application!

About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Portuguese Brazilian speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Portuguese Brazilian speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Portuguese Brazilian , and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Portuguese Brazilian and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the Portuguese Brazilian experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Portuguese Brazilian, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

 

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

If you're a native-level Portuguese Brazilianspeaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.

At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech?
 
Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI.
 
By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms.
 
Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation.
 
What You’ll Need
- Native or near-native fluency in Azerbaijani
- Based in: Azerbaijan, Remote
- English proficiency
- Comfortable with digital tools
- Detail-oriented and curious

🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow
🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI
🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community

Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.

Overview

Welo Data is looking for sharp, curious, and detail-oriented individuals to join our team as Data Labeling Associate.

This is not a traditional annotation role.

You’ll be working directly with cutting-edge AI systems — evaluating outputs, identifying gaps, and helping improve how these systems behave in real-world scenarios. The work sits at the intersection of data quality, model evaluation, and human judgment, where your ability to think critically matters just as much as following guidelines.

We’re looking for people who are naturally curious about AI, comfortable forming opinions, and confident in contributing to conversations with teammates, leads, and stakeholders.

About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Polish speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Polish speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Polish, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Polish and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the Polish experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated.

If you're a native-level Polish speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com  


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Welo Global is partnering with a social media client to build high-quality training data for AI systems. We are looking for Brazilian experts with PhD level to help create challenging, expert-level questions and answers in their field. The content that will directly shape how AI understands Brazilian culture, law, history, and society.

This is a remote, flexible freelance engagement. All work is done in Brazilian Portuguese.

What you'll do

For each assignment, you will craft a challenging, expert-level question on a Brazilian topic in your field (one that AI tools cannot fully answer), write the ideal response in Brazilian Portuguese and break that response down into individually cited facts with their sources and relevance.

Important: AI tools may be used for research support only. All questions, answers, and fact breakdowns must be your own original work.

We are looking for experts in the domain listed in the job posting. As a mandatory requirement, only experts with PhD level would be considered for the role.

  • Task: AI data annotation
  • Area of expertise (domain): History
  • Tools: Consumer-grade LLM with search (e.g., Gemini Pro), for prompt difficulty calibration
  • Estimated Volume: 60 hours over approximately 2 months, the hours are flexible, work on your own schedule
  • Location: Remote
  • Engagement Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor

extra.description_html:
About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Urdu (Romanized) speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Urdu (Romanized) speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Urdu (Romanized), and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Urdu (Romanized) and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the Urdu (Romanized) experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Urdu (Romanized), written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

 

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

If you're a native-level Urdu (Romanized) speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

About Welo Life Sciences 

Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications.  welolifesciences.com

About the Role

We are looking for experienced English into German linguists specializing in Clinical-trial, Pharmacovigilance and Regulatory document translation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate clinical research, regulatory and pharmacovigilance documents from English to German.
  • Perform Machine Translation Post-Editing (MTPE) on machine-translated safety content.
  • Perform Copy Edit (translation review) of translated/post-edited content for accuracy, tone, and consistency.
  • Meet strict, non-extendable turnaround times on time-sensitive content.
  • Work within the client's CAT tool environment (XTM/Phrase), also Track Changes in Microsoft Word following project-specific setup instructions.

Field of Expertise

  • Clinical Research Documents (protocols and synopses, IB, ICF, Patient Sheets, Patient Diaries)
  • Regulatory Documents (SmPC, PIL, Labels, CTD Modules)
  • Pharmacovigilance Documents (PSUR, DSUR, RMP, SAE and AE)

Must-Have Criteria

  • Applicant must meet at least one of the following criteria:

Education

  • A degree in Translation, Linguistics, or Language Studies (or an equivalent degree) or
  • Recognized graduate qualification in any other field, plus a minimum of two years of full-time professional experience in translation or
  • A minimum of five years of full-time professional experience in translation

Relevant translation experience

  • At least two years of practical translation experience, specifically with life sciences (clinical trials and pharmacovigilance) and medical documents

Technical Skills

  • Familiarity with CAT tools (XTM/Phrase), License will be provided.
  • Familiarity with Track Changes in Microsoft Word

Nice-to-Have

  • Degree in Medicine, Biology, Biochemistry, Clinical Research, Translation, Linguistics, Philology or similar
  • In-house industry experience at a CRO or pharmaceutical company.

Before Applying

Please note there will be an assessment as part of our onboarding and quality procedure, please only apply if you're willing to complete our assessment.
 
Please ensure your latest English CV accurately reflects your Life Sciences and Medical translation experience, including years of experience specifically in Life Sciences, the document types you’ve translated, CAT tool you've used, and relevant details also your contact information (email AND phone number).
 
Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global
 
We look forward to receiving your application!

extra.description_html:
About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level English (from UK) speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level English (from UK) speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in English (from UK), and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model output in English (from UK)and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material. 

  • Test the English (from UK) experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly. 

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated. 

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved. 

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch. 

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme. 

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed. 

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual English (from UK), written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical. 

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android. 

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality. 

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English. 

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail. 

 

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously. 

If you're a native-level English (from UK) speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

Welo Data is looking for sharp, curious, and detail-oriented individuals to join our team as Data Labeling Associate.

This is not a traditional annotation role.

You’ll be working directly with cutting-edge AI systems — evaluating outputs, identifying gaps, and helping improve how these systems behave in real-world scenarios. The work sits at the intersection of data quality, model evaluation, and human judgment, where your ability to think critically matters just as much as following guidelines.

We’re looking for people who are naturally curious about AI, comfortable forming opinions, and confident in contributing to conversations with teammates, leads, and stakeholders.

Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.

At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech?
 
Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI.
 
By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms.
 
Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation.
 
What You’ll Need
- Native or near-native fluency in English
- Based in: Malaysia, India, Philippines, Indonesia
- English proficiency
- Comfortable with digital tools
- Detail-oriented and curious
 
Why Join Us?
🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow
🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI
🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community
 
About our projects:
Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.
Depending on your skills, you might:
📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems
🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance
💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs)
🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy
Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you.
 
How to Apply?
Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community.
 
📬 Questions?
If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.

検索エンジンに関する豊富な知識、ほんの数語で求める結果を引き出す効率のいい検索のノウハウ、相手が話し終わる前に話の趣旨を察する理解力－－そうしたスキルを活かせるまたとない機会です。 

現在Welocalizeは、ウェブ検索結果品質評価者としてお客様のプロジェクトをサポートする、日本在住の日本語話者を募集しています。

オンラインエクスペリエンス向上のため、人々の意図を汲み取る貴重な才能を活かしませんか？

今回のプロジェクトの主な目的は、AIデータの開発と拡張です。
品質評価者は、プロジェクトのルールや決まりに基づいた、広告の主観的および客観的な評価を担当します。インターネット検索の最前線に身を置き、業界を牽引しませんか？ 

プロジェクトの詳細

職名: ウェブ検索結果品質評価者
仕事内容:ウェブ検索結果の品質向上のため、表示された検索結果の評価、そしてフィードバックの送信（タスクは主に日本語ですが、英語の評価内容もあります）
タスクはアサインされることはなく、ご自身の都合がよい時間や、スキマ時間にツールにログインしていただき、タスクをご自身で行っていただく形式となります。一週間にどれくらい働いたかなどもご自身での管理をお願いいたします。実際に行われたタスクは評価ツールに記録され、それに基づきお支払いが送られてきます。
勤務地: 在宅勤務（日本在住であること） 
勤務時間: 週5～20時間、ご自身でスケジュール調整可（繁忙期、閑散期あり） 
開始日: 登録後すぐ
雇用形態: フリーランス/業務委託


この業務は、プロジェクトの需要に基づき発生するフリーランス業務です。
週ごとに勤務時間が変動する可能性があるため、ご了承の程お願いいたします。

About Welocalize 

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Spanish (LATAM) speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programe for a major global technology and communications client. 

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in Spanish (LATAM), and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Review pre-release AI model outputs in Spanish (LATAM) and evaluate them for accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality—would a native speaker say it this way? Fact-check each response against the provided source material. 

  • Test the Spanish (LATAM) experience against English: confirm feature parity, complete an end-to-end user journey using non-English input, and verify that the product correctly handles non-Latin scripts, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input.

  • Identify any display issues (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering poorly) and any localization errors—incorrect dates, numbers, currencies, units, or untranslated strings.

  • Document each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it—include steps taken, device and OS, locale, build ID, and supporting evidence. Retest after a fix ships to confirm it’s resolved.

  • Provide native-level insights on navigation and usability, calling out Spanish (LATAM)-specific nuances that only a fluent speaker would notice.

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office; due to the confidential, pre-release nature of the work, remote or work-from-home options are not available.

  • Assist with other linguistic projects as needed.

 

JOB REQUIREMENTS  

  • Native-level or fully bilingual proficiency in Spanish (LATAM), written and spoken, with an up-to-date sense of real-world usage across both everyday and technical contexts.

  • Confident using smartphones and laptops; comfortable working across both iOS and Android.

  • Strong attention to detail and fair, objective judgment when assessing quality.

  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed test scripts and guidelines, and clearly explain issues in English.

  • Previous experience in software/app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus, but not required if you bring the language skills and attention to detail.

 

Welocalize helps the world’s leading brands reach global audiences—and language testing is at the core of that mission. You’ll work alongside experienced linguists and testers on pre-release technology, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously.

If you’re a native-level Spanish (LATAM) speaker with a keen eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology intersect, we’d like to hear from you.
